# pull works is too long

Speed up `pull`: its automatic stash step used `git staaash` — `git stash --all`, which also stashes ignored files — so on a repository with a large `vendor/`, `node_modules/` or build directory the stash took longer than the pull itself. The proposal: stash only tracked changes with a plain `git stash`.
